Delicious American / British Chinese Food
Feb 2026 • Friends
What a lovely restaurant!

If you like American / British Chinese food, I highly recommend you visit the Mayflower restaurant.

Service:
- Welcoming, Friendly and Professional
- A simple but nice little touch was that you can choose your own chop stick design.
- The waiter also provided some complimentary crackers with chilli dipping sauce.
- Rating: 5/5

Atmosphere:
- The decor is minimalistic and cool.
- The seats are comfortable and the temperature was perfect.
- They played some lovely Chinese music, which wasn’t too loud and helped to enhance the atmosphere.
- Although the restaurant wasn’t full, i really enjoyed the vibe.
- Rating: 5/5

My Order:

- 1 x Chicken Chow Mein
- Good portion size and Delicious
- The chicken was tender, juicy and the noodles were cooked perfectly.
- Price:150K
- Rating: 5/5

- 1 x Dad’s Black Bean Pepper
- Again, good portion size and delicious
- The beef was tender, juicy and came with rice.
- Price: 175K
- Rating: 5/5

- 1 x Orange Peel Chicken
- Again, good portion size and delicious
- The chicken was tender, juicy and you could really taste the orange. It also came with rice.
- Price:145K
- Rating: 5/5

After the meal, they also provided a complimentary fortune cookie.

Overall Rating: 5/5

Thank you Mayflower team for a lovely lunch.

See you soon

John & Rose, Excellent Meal
Apr 2026 • Couples
We had a fantastic dining experience at Mayflower American Restaurant during our stay in Da Nang, and it quickly became one of our favourite places to eat. In fact, we enjoyed it so much that we dined here twice, and would have happily returned again if we’d had more time.

The restaurant itself has a nice interior, with a warm, welcoming atmosphere that makes it a great spot to relax and enjoy a meal. The menu is extensive, offering plenty of choice, so there’s something for everyone.

On both visits, the food was excellent. We ordered dishes like the Kung Pao chicken, egg fried rice, and chow mein noodles, all of which were full of flavour and cooked perfectly. Everything was well-seasoned, and clearly prepared with care.

What really stood out, though, was the service. The staff were consistently attentive, friendly, and professional, making us feel genuinely welcome from the moment we arrived. 

A special touch was when the manager came over to chat with us and shared the history of the restaurant’s owner, it was a lovely story and added a personal feel to the whole experience.

All in all, a wonderful restaurant with great food, excellent service, and a memorable atmosphere. Highly recommended if you’re visiting Da Nang.
